name: Deep Ritz Method
summary: Approximate PDE solutions by minimizing a variational energy functional parameterized by a neural network.
core_idea: Represent trial functions with a neural network and optimize a discretized energy integral rather than pointwise strong residual.
innovation: Provides a neural variational solver that exploits an available energy/weak formulation.
limitations: Requires a suitable variational functional for the governing problem.
Boundary-condition enforcement and quadrature can affect accuracy.

start_here.why: Original neural Ritz scheme that is easily contrasted with strong-residual methods.
start_here.focus: Energy minimization and representative variational PDE examples.

curation_note: Scholarly source and method contribution checked; starting references are suggestions, not mandatory reading.
